name: Commercial Kitchen Waste Management Plan
search_intent: Hospitality business owners, caterers, and environmental hygiene officers seeking a structured waste management procedure and audit checklist covering general refuse, dry mixed recycling, used cooking oil (UCO), and Category 3 Animal By-Products (ABP).

competitors.title: Food Waste Management Action Plan | WRAP UK
competitors.strengths: National benchmark data on food waste reduction.
competitors.weaknesses: Macro-level corporate policy report, lacks ready-to-use operational kitchen checklist.

competitors.title: Hospitality Food Waste Reduction Plan | Zero Waste Scotland
competitors.weaknesses: Dense PDF guide, lacks interactive digital auditing and printable shift checklists.

competitors.title: Handling Food Waste in a Food Business | Food Standards Agency
competitors.strengths: Authoritative guidance on ABP Category 3 segregation and pest prevention.
competitors.weaknesses: Short generic webpage, no structured daily/weekly compliance log or tool.

competitors.title: Business Food Waste Reduction Guide | Hubbub
competitors.strengths: Accessible design and staff engagement tips.
competitors.weaknesses: Promotional non-profit content, no legal Duty of Care audit trail or technical specs.

competitors.title: Commercial Food Waste Collection | Biffa
competitors.weaknesses: Pure commercial sales pitch to sign bin collection contracts, no free internal audit tool.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: General policy overviews or corporate bin contract marketing.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: Interactive digital audit checklist tracking internal bin segregation, UCO bunded storage, ABP Cat 3 separation, corral hygiene, and waste transfer note documentation.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Complete digital audit suite aligned with the UK Environmental Protection Act 1990 Section 34 and Animal By-Products Regulations 2013, with real-time signoff and CSV export.
